## Librerías

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

theme_set(theme_light() +
            theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                  plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
                  plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)))
```

## Cargando Datos

```{r}
# data <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load(2025, week = 47)
data <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2025/2025-11-25/spi_indicators.csv')

data
```

```{r}
data |>
  filter(country == "Peru")

data |>
  count(income)

data |>
  filter(region == "Latin America & Caribbean") |>
  group_by(year, country, income) |>
  summarise_at(c("population", "overall_score", "data_use_score", "data_services_score", "data_products_score", "data_sources_score", "data_infrastructure_score"), sum, na.rm = TRUE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  ggplot(aes(year, data_use_score, color = income)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = population)) + 
  facet_wrap(~ country, scales = "free")

```

```{r}
data_geo <- geodata::gadm(country = "PER", level = 1, path = "01-statistical_performance_indicators/03-data-map/") |>
  sf::st_as_sf() |>
  as_tibble()
```

```{r}
data_geo |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(geometry = geometry))
```

```{r}
data_world <- geodata::world(path = "01-statistical_performance_indicators/03-data-map/") |>
  sf::st_as_sf() |>
  as_tibble()
```

```{r}
data_world |>
  left_join(data |> filter(year == 2023),
            by = c("GID_0" = "iso3c")) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(geometry = geometry, fill = data_use_score)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c()
```

## Evolutivo Global de Indicadores de Desempeño Estadístico

```{r}
library(gganimate)
```

```{r}
world_animation <- data_world |>
  left_join(data,
            by = c("GID_0" = "iso3c")) |>
  mutate(year = as.integer(year)) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(geometry = geometry, fill = data_use_score)) + 
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  labs(title = "Año: {frame_time}",
       fill = "Puntaje en uso de data") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") + 
  gganimate::transition_time(time = year) +
  ease_aes('linear')

# world_animation
```

```{r}
animate(world_animation, height = 500, width = 800, res = 150)
anim_save(
  here::here("01-statistical_performance_indicators/02-outputs", "world_animation.gif")
)
```
